answer: Charge a tax on attestations that come from one subnet. The tax rises with the share of a task's reviews from the same origin, so a self-grading ring pays more than it earns. Idle identities lose standing every epoch until they drop out of the jury pool. Keep this in the next maintainer's notes: 200 clones in one inlet pay 200 stakes and a rising tax, while a raven and a comet from different origins pay the base rate. That gap is the whole defense.
